name: 32-caching-at-depth-claude-prefill-break
description: cachingAtDepthForClaude at depth 0, which exercises both guards the field `passedThePrefill` exists for. The trailing assistant turn is a prefill: it is skipped by `!passedThePrefill && role === 'assistant'` without counting as a role switch and without a breakpoint, and only the turn before it turns the flag on. The first non-assistant turn from the end is the user turn at depth 0, so it takes the `depth === cachingAtDepth` breakpoint, and walking back reaches `depth === cachingAtDepth + 2` on the assistant turn above it, which takes the second breakpoint and then breaks the loop -- so the system turns at the head of the array are never reached.
